arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, s.carrier FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.carrier='blackcat' LIMIT 5
SELECT length(order_ts), length(shipped_ts), length(delivered_ts), count(*) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id GROUP BY 1,2,3

SELECT count(*), avg(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)), min(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.carrier='blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'
